description: Retrieve Public Assistance (PA) funded project records, including recipient name, damage category, project status, and federal obligations. Supply disaster_number from fema_search_disasters or a state code. A page holds up to 100,000 characters of projects. Use next_offset to continue. With DataCanvas enabled, an overflowing first page also stages up to 50,000 matching rows for fema_dataframe_query.

canvas_id.description: Reuse a canvas returned by an earlier call. Used only when staging from offset 0; omit to stage on a new canvas.

county.description: Filter by county name (e.g., Harris, dekalb). Case-insensitive substring match: harris also matches Harrison. Recognized terminal County, Parish, Borough, and Census Area names accept plain or parenthesized types; unknown names retain original case fallbacks.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number to scope results to a single declaration. Numbers above 32767 match no declaration.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (1–10000, default 100). A page also stops at 100,000 characters of projects (roughly 220 projects); when either bound leaves matching projects out, next_offset names the offset to continue from.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Pass the previous page’s next_offset to continue.

state.description: Two-letter state code to browse all PA projects for a state.

name: fema_get_public_assistance

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID for querying the staged projects. Present after successful staging.

canvas_tables.description: Staged table metadata. Present after successful staging.

items.description: One staged Public Assistance project table.

staged_count.description: Number of filtered records staged in this table.

table_name.description: Table name for fema_dataframe_describe and SQL FROM clauses.

truncated.description: True when this table holds the first 50,000 of more matching records.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: The state parameter is not a valid 2-letter US state/territory code. `missing_filter`: Neither disaster_number nor state was provided. `not_found`: The disaster number is above 32767, the highest number OpenFEMA holds, so no declaration exists. `request_too_long`: The county value makes the request URL longer than the roughly 8,900 characters OpenFEMA accepts. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas supplied for PA staging is missing or expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page: offset plus returned_count. Present only while matching projects remain past this page; pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Guidance on missing matches, inline continuation, incomplete applicant names, or DataCanvas staging.

projects.description: Public assistance funded project records from offset onward, bounded by limit and by 100,000 characters of projects.

items.description: A single Public Assistance funded project record.

applicant_id.description: FEMA applicant identifier for the recipient organization. Absent when not recorded.

applicant_name.description: Recipient organization name from the applicant record for this disaster and applicant ID.

application_title.description: The application's free-form project title. Absent when not recorded.

county.description: County where the project is located. Absent when not recorded.

county_fips.description: Five-digit county FIPS code, including leading zeros. Absent when either component is unavailable.

damage_category_code.description: FEMA damage category code (e.g., A=Debris Removal, B=Emergency Protective Measures, C=Roads and Bridges). Absent when unclassified.

damage_category_description.description: Human-readable name for the damage category code. Absent when unclassified.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number this project belongs to.

federal_share_obligated.description: Federal dollars obligated for this project in USD; 0 when nothing is obligated.

first_obligation_date.description: ISO 8601 date the first federal obligation was recorded. Absent before obligation.

last_obligation_date.description: ISO 8601 date the latest federal obligation was recorded. Absent before obligation.

mitigation_amount.description: Proposed Section 406 mitigation amount in USD, including zero and negative adjustments.

project_amount.description: Estimated total eligible cost of the project in USD from FEMA's damage survey, without administrative costs. Absent when not yet determined.

project_process_step.description: Current FEMA project workflow step. Absent when not recorded.

project_size.description: Large or Small, set by comparing the eligible amount from the damage survey with the large-project threshold FEMA sets for each fiscal year. Absent when unclassified.

project_status.description: Eligibility status of the project: Eligible (nearly all projects), Pending Eligibility Review, Ineligible, or Withdrawn. Absent when not set.

pw_number.description: Project Worksheet number assigned by FEMA. Absent when not yet assigned.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation. Absent when not recorded.

total_obligated.description: Federal share of the eligible project amount plus State (recipient) and applicant (subrecipient) administrative costs, in USD; equals federal_share_obligated when no administrative costs are recorded. Holds no non-federal share. 0 when nothing is obligated.

returned_count.description: Number of projects in this response.

spilled.description: Whether the filtered match was staged on a DataCanvas.

totalCount.description: Total matching projects before pagination — exceeds returned_count when results were capped at the limit.

title: Get FEMA Public Assistance Projects
